name: RO Antiscalant
desc: Stops CaCO3, CaSO4, BaSO4 and silica scale on RO membranes. Runs continuously on every plant. Dose 2-5 ppm.

name: Membrane Cleaner - Acidic (CIP-A)
desc: Low-pH CIP cleaner that dissolves carbonate/sulphate scale, iron and metal-oxide fouling. Dose 1-2% solution.

name: Membrane Cleaner - Alkaline (CIP-B)
desc: High-pH CIP cleaner for organic matter, biofilm, oils and colloidal fouling. Dose 1-2% solution.

name: RO Biocide / Preservative
desc: Non-oxidising biocide for microbial control while running and membrane preservation during idle periods. Dose 20-30 ppm.

name: SMBS - Dechlorination Chemical
desc: Sodium metabisulphite that neutralises residual free chlorine before it reaches the membrane. Dose approx 3 mg per mg Cl2.

name: RO pH Booster (Powder)
desc: Raises permeate or feed pH; stops aggressive RO water corroding pipes, tanks and fittings. Dose 5-25 ppm.

name: Boiler Oxygen Scavenger
desc: Sulphite/amine based scavenger that removes dissolved oxygen from feed water before it pits the boiler tubes. Dose 20-50 ppm.

name: Boiler Antiscalant
desc: Conditions residual hardness into free-flowing sludge that leaves with blowdown instead of hard scale on tubes. Dose 5-15 ppm.

name: Boiler Alkalinity / pH Builder
desc: Holds boiler water alkalinity and pH in the correct band to avoid embrittlement and stop corrosion. Dose per boiler water test.

name: Condensate Corrosion Inhibitor
desc: Neutralising amine that travels with the steam and protects the whole condensate return line from carbonic acid. Dose 10-20 ppm.

name: Cooling Tower Scale & Corrosion Inhibitor
desc: Multi-functional formulation that controls scale and protects mild steel and yellow metals across the circuit. Dose 50-100 ppm.

name: Cooling Tower Oxidising Biocide
desc: Chlorine/bromine based routine control of bacteria and algae, maintained as a free residual in circulating water. Dose 1-2 ppm free residual.

name: Cooling Tower Non-Oxidising Biocide
desc: Broad-spectrum shock dose that penetrates established biofilm and reaches organisms oxidising biocide cannot. Dose 50-100 ppm shock.

name: Cooling Tower Algaecide
desc: Targeted control of algae in basins, distribution decks and fill packing where sunlight reaches wet surfaces. Dose 20-30 ppm.
